name: zark backup status
description:
Shows the state of zark backups in the top bar: the last backup to each drive, a running backup's progress, when zark waits for an answer in its terminal, and how full the system pools are.

Read-only: it reads the status files zark 2.1 or later writes, and never starts, stops or changes anything. Backups stay sudo zark backup in a terminal.

Clipboard: the "Copy the backup command" menu item and notification button put sudo zark backup on the clipboard. Nothing is read from it.
